messageCenterItems.title: Plan for Change: Updates to policy-related reporting in Microsoft Intune Data Warehouse
messageCenterItems.summary: Starting January 4, 2027, Microsoft Intune Data Warehouse will update policy-related reporting collections, possibly causing changes in policy-status counts. Existing connections and schemas remain unchanged, and no action is required. Differences from Intune admin center reports may occur due to timing and aggregation.
messageCenterItems.body:
Starting January 4, 2027, or soon after, we are updating Microsoft Intune Data Warehouse infrastructure to align policy-related reporting with updated Intune reporting infrastructure. This update applies to the following collections:

  • policyDeviceActivities
  • policyTypeActivities
  • policyUserActivities
  • deviceConfigurationProfileDeviceActivities
  • deviceConfigurationProfileUserActivities
  • compliancePolicyStatusDeviceActivities
  • compliancePolicyStatusDevicePerPolicyActivities

How this will affect your organization:

Existing Data Warehouse connections and report schemas will remain unchanged. Following this update, you may notice differences in policy-status counts in reports that use the affected collections. 

Note: Counts in Data Warehouse may also differ from reports in the Intune admin center due to differences in refresh timing and data aggregation.

What you need to do to prepare:

No action is required. If your organization uses the affected collections for custom reporting or analysis, you may notice that policy-status counts may change following the update.

Learn more: Use the Intune Data Warehouse - Microsoft Intune | Microsoft Learn

messageCenterItems.title: Plan for Change: Updated web-based device enrollment experience for iOS/iPadOS
messageCenterItems.summary: Microsoft Intune will update the web-based device enrollment experience for iOS/iPadOS in late January 2027, affecting only tenants using this method. No admin action is needed, but user guidance may be updated. This change precedes web-based enrollment becoming the default for iOS/iPadOS.
messageCenterItems.body:
Expected in late January 2027, Microsoft Intune will introduce an updated user experience for iOS/iPadOS web-based device enrollment. This change applies only to tenants that already use web-based device enrollment as an enrollment profile.

This update is part of our continued investment in web-based device enrollment ahead of web-based device enrollment becoming the default enrollment method for iOS/iPadOS in early 2027, as previously communicated in MC1476216.

How this will affect your organization:

Users enrolling iOS/iPadOS devices with web-based device enrollment will see an updated enrollment experience. There is no impact to existing enrollment profile configuration, and no admin action is required.

Note: This change does not impact other iOS/iPadOS enrollment profile types.

What you need to do to prepare:

No action is required. You may want to update your internal user guidance or helpdesk documentation to reflect the updated enrollment experience. You can learn more and view a demo of the new experience in the blog: Use web-based device enrollment for BYOD enrollment on iOS/iPadOS

Additional information:

Set up web based device enrollment for iOS
